name: Apple TV
verdict: Apple Inc. is a Nasdaq-listed US company; its 2026 proxy statement lists The Vanguard Group (9.63%) and BlackRock, Inc. (7.10%) as its only holders above 5%. Nothing found.
note: League-wide sleeve-patch sponsor of MLS; the patch sits on the left sleeve of every club's first-team kit. No state or state fund in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against Apple Inc. itself found (searched 4 Oct 2026).
